skill.displayName: Remove Text from Video online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: Remove text from video online free — remove text overlays or watermarks from a video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill to remove text overlays or watermarks from videos online for free.
- Provides endpoints to start removal jobs, poll run status, and upload images.
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication; prompts only if not already set in the environment.
- Supports input of video URLs and optional watermark detection mode (default: autoDetect).
- Includes polling instructions and output retrieval details.
